messages:
maria-seceng: Quick proposal — create timeboxed, ephemeral log snapshots for incident triage. snapshots are encrypted with customer KMS, stored in a short-lived bucket, and access granted via one-time tokens. want feedback on RBAC + audit chain.
raj-sre: sounds useful. what's the lifecycle? how short is "timeboxed"?
maria-seceng: thinking 7 days by default, option to reduce to 24h for high-sensitivity incidents. snapshots auto-delete and we keep a tamper-evident hash in the audit index.
kevin-platform: how are we granting access? temporary role or presigned URL? need to avoid long-lived creds.
maria-seceng: temporary STS assume-role -> KMS Grant for Decrypt scoped to the object. access flow: analyst requests snapshot in convo, system creates object, issues one-time presigned URL + ephemeral KMS grant, logs grant id to audit stream. example:
```
# flow (simplified)
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123:role/incident-analyst --duration-seconds 900
# create kms grant scoped to object key and principal
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-logs --grantee-principal <assumed-role-arn> --operations Decrypt --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"snapshot-id":"s-123"}}'
```
elaine-legal: we need clear metadata stored: who requested, justification, incident id, TTL. also retention must be defensible for legal holds — we can't auto-delete if there's an active hold.
maria-seceng: agreed — if a legal hold flag exists, snapshot moves to a hold bucket and retention is frozen until cleared. default behavior still auto-delete otherwise.
samir-oncall: practical Q — if an analyst downloads and copies sensitive logs locally, how do we enforce? inability to fully prevent exfil, but we can limit window + watermark + watermarking in file and require acknowledgement in ticketing system. also log every download event to SIEM.
kevin-platform: add one-time-use watermark token inside archive and require HQ policy for local copies. also add redaction helper for PII before snapshot creation.
raj-sre: operational concern — KMS grants can pile up. do we revoke them after TTL or rely on grant expiry? AWS grants don't have TTL; we'll need to track grant IDs and schedule revoke calls. that's additional job.
maria-seceng: good catch. plan: create ephemeral grants + store grant-id in audit stream, background job revokes grant after 10m post-download or at snapshot TTL. if revoke fails, escalate.
audit-bot: Reminder: retention-policy v3.2 requires exported artifacts to include immutable hash and exporter principal. See /ops/retention/retention-policy.md
elaine-legal: one more: chain-of-custody. store a signed ledger entry (hash + signer) in central vault so we can verify later. legal wants accessible records for subpoenas.
maria-seceng: will add signed ledger and link to incident ticket. also will include a small hash manifest inside the snapshot: SHA256 per file + manifest.sig.
kevin-platform: are we comfortable with putting snapshots into S3 in same account vs cross-account storage? cross-account (dedicated evidence account) is safer for tamper-proofing.
maria-seceng: prefer dedicated evidence account with restricted write-only ingest role; that way platform can't modify existing object except via documented retention/handover.
samir-oncall: how does this interact with SIEM exports? we already stream events for analysis. snapshots are full context bundles (logs + traces + kv cache dumps). we should avoid duplicating data in long-term SIEM buckets.
maria-seceng: snapshots are ad-hoc, not continuous exports. SIEM export remains for long-term detection signals. snapshot creation should be rate-limited and audited to avoid exfil channels.
raj-sre: action items?
maria-seceng: I will draft runbook + RBAC matrix: roles, allowed TTLs, grant lifecycle, watermark scheme, legal-flag integration. will propose revoker lambda code and the evidence-account IAM model.
kevin-platform: I'll review and scope the background revoke worker and S3 lifecycle rules.
elaine-legal: I'll add legal-hold checks and required metadata fields.
samir-oncall: I'll update the incident playbook to include request flow and checklist for watermark/ack.
maria-seceng: Thanks — I'll post RFC in #eng-security-docs when ready. ping me if you hit a compliance edge case. :thumbsup:
